claims.text: Uniswap Labs announced the protocol crossed $4 trillion in cumulative volume on December 2, 2025, reaching each successive trillion faster than the last
CoinGecko's own DEX-versus-CEX spot-volume tracker shows DEX share rising from 6.9% in January 2024 to a peak of 24.5% in June 2025, then falling back to 13.6% by January 2026
The Block's separately-constructed ratio ... a record 24.14% in July 2026, up from 17% twelve months earlier
PancakeSwap's June 2025 spike to 58% of all DEX activity ... traced to Binance's Alpha 2.0 program mechanically routing its own retail order flow into PancakeSwap pools
Jack Bogle's 1976 Vanguard First Index Investment Trust was mocked as Bogle's Folly and raised just over $11 million against a target of $50-150 million
index-based funds hold roughly 52-54% of US long-term fund assets, up from roughly 19% in 2010, per ICI Fact Book data
index funds reportedly average roughly 0.11% versus 0.59% for active funds, and a widely-cited estimate puts active-fund underperformance near 88% over ten years (marked ==unverified== in body)
a 2021 study spanning 17 Uniswap v3 pools found LPs collectively earned $199.3 million in fees but suffered $260.1 million in impermanent/divergence loss
a pool needs roughly 10% of its value to turn over in daily volume just to break even on a typical fee tier (LVR)
Citadel Securities posted $12.2 billion in net trading revenue in 2025, a 25% increase over 2024's $9.7 billion record, ending the year with $21 billion in trading capital and $6.5 billion in EBITDA
Citadel Securities' revenue-to-capital ratio ... has held roughly flat ... and its revenue fell 35% in the first half of 2023 versus the first half of 2022
competitors Jane Street and Hudson River Trading have both been reported gaining share since 2024
More than 75% of orders routed to TD Ameritrade executed at the mid-price or better; only 25% of orders routed to Robinhood did
Curve's stETH/ETH pool depegged in June 2022 ... pool TVL fell from $4.6 billion to about $621 million within weeks, and stETH separately traded as low as 0.9671 ETH ... during a later stress episode
UST/LUNA ... failed even more completely two weeks earlier, wiping out roughly $18 billion of UST and $40 billion of LUNA market value within days
NVDA's rolling 30-day correlation with the S&P 500 has ranged between 0.35 and 0.87 over the past year (averaging roughly 0.66)
NVDA's beta versus the broader market is reported between 1.88 and 2.24 depending on vendor and lookback window

Uniswap v4's hooks are a genuine architectural advance ... a separate v4 change, a singleton contract plus flash accounting, cuts gas costs by roughly 99%; the gas savings trace to that architectural redesign, not to hooks themselves
DualPool parks idle pool capital in ERC-4626 yield vaults between swaps ... Spark's separate $150 million migration ... is explicitly earmarked to eventually route through DualPool

Robinhood Chain ... went live July 1, 2026 ... Stock Tokens are structured as 1:1-backed tokenized debt securities, issued by a Jersey special-purpose vehicle ... carry no voting or shareholder rights
$33 million in volume from more than 11,000 traders in the first twelve days, on a single tokenized SPY pair
Uniswap V3 and V4 combined control roughly 99% of tokenized-stock DEX liquidity on Robinhood Chain
a large share of Robinhood Chain's tokenized-stock DEX volume has been traced to memecoins launched using stock tokens as their liquidity-pool collateral

DTCC ... running production pilot trades of its own tokenization platform since July 2026 under an SEC No-Action Letter, with more than 50 participating firms including BlackRock, Goldman Sachs, and JPMorgan
Nasdaq's tokenized-securities rule change, approved by the SEC on March 18, 2026, requires tokenized shares to remain fungible with ... and carry identical shareholder rights
ICE formed a 50-50 joint venture with OKX in June 2026 to put NYSE-listed stocks on-chain for roughly 120 million crypto traders
The SEC's January 28, 2026 joint staff statement holds that federal securities laws apply to tokenized securities in substantially the same way as traditional securities regardless of format

Reporting on its likely scope is contested: some coverage describes it as cabined and time-limited with voting and dividend rights excluded, while other reporting ... suggest the draft could preserve full rights parity
intermediaries facilitating secondary tokenized-securities trades remain subject to the same broker-dealer, exchange, and transfer-agent registration requirements
Uniswap's total value locked fell to about $3.31 billion by March 2026 and roughly $3.42 billion by May 2026 — well below trackers' reports of a prior-year peak above $6 billion
Uniswap's DAO activated a long-dormant protocol fee switch through a UNIfication vote ... including a one-time retroactive burn of 100 million UNI (worth roughly $600 million at vote-time prices)
UNI traded near $3.25 (market cap roughly $2.03 billion) on the day the essay was published, down meaningfully from where it traded at the start of 2026
the SEC closed its multi-year investigation into Uniswap Labs with no enforcement action in February 2025
Uniswap Labs settled with the CFTC for a reduced $175,000 penalty in September 2024 ... with two of five CFTC commissioners publicly dissenting
A federal court also fully dismissed a private class action (Risley v. Universal Navigation Inc.) ... holding that Uniswap's developers are not statutory sellers under securities law
Uniswap Labs' own research found that JIT liquidity ... was relatively rare (roughly 8,000 transactions between May 2021 and July 2022)
an independently documented single case still cut a regular LP's fee accrual from 0.17853 ETH to 0.02223 ETH in one block
